scope: All131 remaining passages from the199-match supplemental lexical scan. Every source needs inclusion/exclusion/dependency disposition; no claim of semantic completeness.

card.name: Sacred Chant
card.effect: Sacred Chant. Tags: chant, sustained, conviction. Pulse on start and once when maintained on each later regular turn with a Bonus Action. Under the base feature, the third pulse generates 1 Conviction. Only a real encounter can generate Conviction this way. Maintenance itself does not otherwise heal, damage or grant Conviction.

source.originalText: Sacred Chant: A sustained prayer that generates 1 Conviction every 3 turns while maintained.

card.name: Miraculous Channel
card.rangeAndTarget: Your next ally-targeting Rite this turn
card.effect: Miraculous Channel. Tags: rite, channel, bishop. Your next Rite this turn that normally affects one or more willing allies may affect up to six legal willing allies within the Rite's normal range instead. Roll shared healing or numeric effects once and apply normally. It does not multiply hostile targets, corpse targets or resource generation.

source.originalText: Miraculous Channel: Sacrificing 3 Conviction causes your next Rite to affect the full party.

card.name: Divine Invocation
card.effect: Divine Invocation. Tags: invocation, bishop. Use only your selected Invocation Path. Radiance: up to 3 allies within 30 feet each regain S d8+M HP; one may end Frightened or Poisoned. Judgment: one enemy within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save, taking (S+1)d8 radiant on failure or half on success; failure also applies Judged for 2 rounds. Renewal: up to 2 allies within 30 feet each regain S d8+M HP and 5 Stamina. Flame: creatures in a 15-foot cone make Dexterity saves, taking (S+1)d8 fire on failure or half on success; failed targets also take 1d6 fire at the start of their next turn. Veil: up to 3 allies within 30 feet can see invisible/ethereal creatures within 30 feet and gain advantage on saves against illusions for 3 rounds. Echoes: choose one eligible Smite or Rite you resolved this turn or previous regular turn and one original target within 30 feet; repeat 50% of its immediate unmodified rolled damage or healing dice, rounded down once, minimum 1 for a positive source, with no copied conditions, resources or triggers.

source.originalText: Divine Invocation: Channel a powerful prayer based on your chosen Invocation Path, with effects ranging from mass healing to divine fire or protective barriers.

card.name: Radiant Burst
card.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot radius centered on you; up to six allies and six Undead/Fiends
card.effect: Radiant Burst. Tags: saint, healing, radiant. Roll S d8 once. Each chosen living ally regains that roll + M HP. Each chosen Undead or Fiend makes a Wisdom save, taking the same S d8 roll as radiant damage on failure or half on success. Healing and damage are separate applications of the shared roll.

source.originalText: Radiant Burst: Release a powerful wave of divine energy that heals allies and damages unholy creatures.

card.name: Scriptural Echo
card.rangeAndTarget: One legal original target of your previously used Divine Invocation
card.effect: Scriptural Echo. Tags: priest, rite, invocation. When you start a Rite, you may repeat 50% of the immediate rolled damage or healing dice from the most recent Divine Invocation you personally resolved since the end of your previous regular turn. Round down once, minimum 1 for a positive source. It copies no conditions, movement, resource effects, control or Invocation Path triggers.

source.originalText: Scriptural Echo: Casting a Rite repeats the Invocation used previously for 50% effect.

card.name: Balanced Scales
card.rangeAndTarget: Living creatures healed by your Cleric features
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most once per marked ally per round
card.effect: Balanced Scales. Tags: priest, healing, retaliation. After you restore HP to a living ally, mark it until the start of your next regular turn. The first enemy to damage that ally during the mark takes S + M radiant damage. The retaliation is not an attack, cannot critically hit and cannot recursively trigger another Balanced Scales event.

source.originalText: Balanced Scales: Enemies take divine damage if they attack healed targets.

card.name: Balance Restoration
card.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius area centered at a point within 30 feet
card.effect: Balance Restoration. Tags: priest, healing, radiant. Choose up to three living allies and three enemies in the area. Roll S d8 once. Each ally regains the roll + M HP. Each enemy makes a Wisdom save, taking the same S d8 roll as radiant damage on failure or half on success.

source.originalText: Balance Restoration: Channel divine energy that both heals allies and damages enemies in an area, maintaining cosmic balance.

card.name: Word of Power
card.effect: Word of Power. Tags: priest, divine. Choose one mode. Mercy: one willing living creature regains S d8+M HP. Rebuke: one Undead or Fiend makes a Constitution save, taking (S+1)d8 radiant on failure or half on success; failure also removes its Reaction until the start of its next turn. Command: one other hostile creature makes a Wisdom save; failure knocks it Prone and removes its Reaction until the start of its next turn. No mode changes beliefs, loyalty or ideology.

source.originalText: Word of Power: Speak a divine word that has different effects based on the target's nature and actions.

card.name: Zealot's Touch
card.effect: Zealot's Touch. Tags: cultist, rite, necrotic. When starting a Rite whose printed pulse would restore HP over multiple turns, you may designate a hostile creature instead of a healing recipient. At each applicable pulse that enemy makes a Wisdom save. On failure it takes necrotic damage equal to the Rite's rolled healing dice; on success it takes half. Flat healing bonuses are not converted. The enemy receives no healing.

source.originalText: Zealot's Touch: Healing over time effects become life drain if cast on enemies.

card.name: Dark Sacrament
card.cost: 3 Conviction + 5 RP to start; 1 RP maintenance
card.effect: Dark Sacrament. Tags: cultist, sacrament, rite, sustained, zone. On start and each paid maintenance pulse, roll S d6 once. Up to three enemies in the zone make Constitution saves, taking that roll as necrotic damage on failure or half on success. If at least one enemy takes damage, up to three living allies in the zone each regain floor(roll/2)+M HP. Maximum 3 pulses. The Conviction expenditure can vent Dissonance once.

source.originalText: Dark Sacrament: Perform a twisted ritual that drains life from enemies to heal allies or create other beneficial effects.

classRecords.text: Your Bleed is a physical ongoing effect on a living, non-bloodless creature: 1d4 damage at the start of each of its next 3 turns, then ends. It is not a new attack and generates no BG or procs. Refresh duration instead of stacking; Blood Echo expressly allows two independent instances, maximum. An Action by the victim or an adjacent creature using a healer's kit ends all your Bleeds on that victim. Apply physical resistance/immunity normally. Track remaining ticks and creator per instance. Allied healing versions from Bloodweaver cost RP and never count as hostile Bleeds for detonation, spreading or generation.

The healing, execution and denial text below deliberately bounds the source's vague percentage/instant-kill claims. HP sacrificed is direct loss, bypasses temporary HP and defenses, cannot be redirected, and cannot reduce the donor below 1. Only a willing ally can donate. HP sacrifice is never damage for class triggers. No class feature here restores the dead or removes Wounds.

card.name: Bloodbound Edge
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies with your Bleed within 30 ft
card.effect: End up to 2 of your Bleed instances per target. Each takes 1d4 per remaining tick, maximum S d4 per creature, ignoring resistance but respecting immunity. This replaces their future ticks and grants no BG, healing or kill-trigger benefit.

source.originalText: Capstone – Bloodbound Edge: Once per rest, convert all Bleeds on enemies to instant True Damage.

card.name: Bloodbond
card.effect: Create Bloodbond while both remain within 30 ft. When ally takes damage, you may use Reaction to redirect floor(one-quarter of pre-mitigation damage) to yourself; each recipient applies its own defenses once. Once/round when a paid technique heals you, ally gains M temporary HP. No recursive transfers.

source.originalText: Bloodbond: Link with an ally; share 25% incoming damage and transfer 10% healing to them.

card.name: Crimson Pact
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 bleeding enemies and 6 living allies within 30 ft
card.effect: End your Bleeds on chosen enemies; each makes CON save against 4d8 necrotic, half on success. Each chosen ally regains 4d8+M HP and gains 10 temporary HP. Use one shared roll per damage/healing effect; healing does not multiply by enemies or remaining ticks.

source.originalText: Final Cut – Crimson Pact: Detonate all enemy Bleeds to heal nearby allies and grant them barriers. (1/day)

card.name: Purify Blood
card.effect: End Poisoned and one nonmagical disease. Magical disease needs a successful INT ability check against its stated treatment DC, or DC 15 if absent; failure spends the cost. No curse, Wound, death or Corruption removal.

source.originalText: Purify Blood: Remove poison, disease, or other blood-borne afflictions from a target.

card.name: Lifewell
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living allies within 15 ft
card.effect: Spend K BG. At start and on each of your next 2 turns, use Bonus Action and pay 1 RP to pulse healing: each chosen ally still within 15 ft regains 1d8+K HP. Without maintenance it ends at turn end. Total 3 pulses; no triggers create more BG.

source.originalText: Lifewell: Ultimate ability that converts all your remaining Blood Gauge into a powerful healing aura for allies.

card.name: Veinburst Requiem
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 6 enemies with your Bleed within 30 ft
card.effect: Spend K BG and end your Bleeds on targets. CON save: (S+K)d8 necrotic, half on success. A target failing by 10 with remaining HP no greater than your class level falls to 0; ordinary death rules follow. No percentage-based automatic boss execution or BG refund.

source.originalText: Final Cut – Veinburst Requiem: Detonates all Bleeds and Blood Gauge effects in range. Enemies under 25% HP are instantly executed. (1/day)

card.name: Crimson Harvest
card.rangeAndTarget: One enemy in weapon reach at half HP or less
card.effect: Make one weapon attack; on hit add S d8 damage. If this reduces it to 0, regain S+M HP and 1 BG within gain cap. No instant kill from a percentage threshold; summoned/allied/helpless creatures yield no recovery.

source.originalText: Crimson Harvest: Execute a heavily wounded target, restoring health and Blood Gauge based on the target's missing health.

classRecords.text: Spending Momentum pays before resolution; a hit refund cannot pay its own activation. Burn means 1d4 fire at start of target's next 2 turns, nonstacking. Bleed means 1d4 physical at start of next 2 turns; an Action with a healer's kit ends it. Do Ts give no Momentum or critical triggers. Hard denial uses the shared once-per-target/encounter guard.

card.name: Wyvern's Guard
card.effect: The next attack that damages you has damage reduced by S d6+M, minimum 0; then the guard ends. Roll the reduction only when damage occurs. This reduction cannot heal or reflect damage.

source.originalText: Wyvern's Guard: Enter a defensive stance that increases your resistance to damage from the next attack.

card.name: Draconic Ward
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 allies within 10 ft
card.effect: Project a ward: chosen creatures while within 10 ft reduce damage by S, minimum 0. The reduction does not stack with Wyrmhide or another flat class reduction. No passive healing or extra Actions.

source.originalText: Draconic Ward: Channel draconic energy to create a protective aura around yourself and nearby allies, reducing incoming damage.

classRecords.text: Transformation reserves prevent unlimited replacement HP: at long rest record Buffer Reserve=2 L+M and Form Surge Reserve=PB. A form giving temporary HP draws that many from Buffer Reserve, up to remaining amount, with normal nonstacking; never real healing. A form special described once/transformation also spends 1 Form Surge and cannot be refreshed by resuming the form. Form Surge refills only long rest. Forms cannot grant free casts, RP or shift uses. Auras affect at most 3 enemies and once per enemy per round; retaliation once/round total; ongoing riders refresh, never stack. Entering a legal Shapeshift clears the Refrain counter and remembered repeated-spell name, as the protected source contract requires. It does not reduce accumulated Dissonance. Natural attacks do not clear Refrain.

card.name: Combat Shapeshifting
card.effect: Restore 1d8 real HP per RP paid, never beyond maximum. Does not restore temporary buffer or shift uses. No Dissonance as class technique; cannot heal after form ended/incapacitated.

source.originalText:
Combat Shapeshifting
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you gain Combat Shapeshifting. While transformed by Shapeshifting, you can use a bonus action to expend one or more Resonance Points, regaining 1d8 hit points for each RP expended. Activating Shapeshifting itself still spends a Shapeshifting use, not RP.

card.name: Echo Channeling
card.effect: After releasing an Echo, add M to one target's damage or healing. No modifier to resource effects; this upgrade does not grant another release or repeat the source's rider.

source.originalText: Echo Channeling: Cast a stored Echo ability. Consumes a slot.

card.name: Advanced Mirrorcall
card.effect: You may change Beast appearance to another stored source as a Bonus Action without resummoning or restoring HP. It gains either+10 ft swim or climb Speed until it ends. No new release, attack or capture.

source.originalText: Advanced Mirrorcall: Mirror Beast can now shift once per fight into a new form based on a second Echo.

card.name: Dual Echo Cast
card.cost: RP for each of 2 Echoes; consume both
card.effect: Release two records captured from different creatures as ONE combined release. Each deals/heals half its profile's rolled amount, round once per component. At most one Hindrance rider; no duplicated resources or additional release this round.

source.originalText: Dual Echo Cast: Spend 2 Echoes in one turn; must be from different creatures.

card.name: Mimicry Focus
card.effect: At genuine encounter start gain 1 Focus Point, cap 1; any previous point is replaced. Spend on Focus Channel or pay 1 Focus during a release to add 1d6 to one damage/healing target. No point generation from staged combat.

source.originalText: Mimicry Focus: Gain +1 Focus Point per battle. Can spend Focus to empower Echoes (double duration/damage).

card.name: Echo Fusion
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 profile targets within 30 ft
card.effect: Choose two stored profiles. Resolve one at full dice and the other at half dice to one target each. Only one may be healing; at most one Hindrance rider. Counts as one combined release and cannot receive Dual Echo Cast simultaneously.

source.originalText: Echo Fusion: Temporarily combine two stored Echoes to create a hybrid ability with properties of both.

card.name: Mirror Shift
card.effect: Switch its appearance to a stored source and choose swim 30 ft or climb 30 ft until next shift. Restore no HP or attacks; no flight, incorporeality or copied creature special actions. Does not release or consume the Echo.

source.originalText: Mirror Shift: Command your Mirror Beast to change form, adopting a different stored Echo ability.

card.name: Focus Channel
card.effect: Next Echo release adds 1d6 to one damage/healing amount OR adds 30 ft range, chosen now. Cannot multiply duration, bypass concentration, add targets or override release caps. If no release occurs this turn the point remains spent.

source.originalText: Focus Channel: Spend a Focus Point to significantly enhance your next Echo cast or Mirror Beast ability.

card.name: Blessed Copy
card.rangeAndTarget: Second living ally within 15 ft of original Mend/Ward target
card.effect: When releasing Mend or Ward, pay 1 extra RP to give a second ally half the rolled amount, rounded once. This is within the same release, no new source or healing proc. No duplication of concentration or resources.

source.originalText: Blessed Copy: Echoed heals or buffs also affect a second ally.

card.name: Radiant Mirror Beast
card.effect: Summon radiant standard Beast. Bonus Action command chooses normal attack or healing S d4 to one living ally within 5 ft, paying 1 RP per heal. It may instead originate your paid Echo release under common limits. Cannot perform two options in one round.

source.originalText: Radiant Mirror Beast: Summon a Mirror Beast infused with divine energy, capable of healing allies and revealing hidden threats.

card.name: Blessing Echo
card.cost: Recorded RP cost+1; consume offensive Echo
card.effect: Convert a stored Strike/Burst record to Mend/Ward for this release, chosen on activation; heal S d6+M or grant same temporary HP. This explicit conversion cannot also deal offensive damage or copy a condition.

source.originalText: Blessing Echo: Transform a captured offensive Echo into a beneficial effect that can heal or protect allies.

card.name: Purifying Reflection
card.rangeAndTarget: Ally within 30 ft failing save against Charmed/Frightened/Poisoned
card.effect: Ally rerolls that save with advantage; use new result. If it succeeds, it regains S d6 HP. No arbitrary curse or death reversal; costs remain if it fails. This is not a captured Echo and creates no record.

source.originalText: Purifying Reflection: Reflect and purify harmful effects, potentially converting them into healing or beneficial effects.

card.name: Mirror Double
card.rangeAndTarget: One damage Echo you released this turn
card.effect: Create one illusory double; it repeats half the unmodified immediate damage dice to one original enemy still within 30 ft, without roll or conditions. Declare Mirror Double before the current turn ends; its pending copy remains part of this turn’s one release package and does not consume a later release allowance. Only one pending copy; cannot copy copies/healing.

source.originalText: Mirror Double: Create a copy of yourself for 1 turn. It casts your last Echo at 50% power.

card.name: Reality Fracture
card.effect: While you stand inside, once/turn add 1d6 to one Echo damage/healing amount or impose-1 on one target's Echo save. Choose before resolving. No free releases, random recasts, resource refunds or extra targets.

source.originalText: Reality Fracture: Create a zone where Echo abilities are enhanced and have a chance to trigger additional effects.

card.name: Fractured Dominion
card.effect: Your first damage release on each of these 2 turns adds one half-dice component against a DIFFERENT enemy within 10 ft of an original target. Same package and shared copy cap; excludes healing/control. Never recursively copies a copy or adds a release action.

source.originalText: Final – Fractured Dominion: For 2 turns, every Echo cast also generates a Glitched Clone Echo that strikes a nearby enemy.

classRecords.text: Ki Chain is a Monk-only resource from 0 to 5. Begin each real encounter at 0 Ki and clear Ki when the encounter ends or after 1 minute without a real encounter. Ki cannot be generated by sparring with willing creatures, attacking objects, repeatedly dodging harmless attacks, healing between encounters or other staged actions. Ki is separate from Resonance Points and Dissonance.

Tiger, Tortoise and Crane Ki generation obey the global Ki-gain ceilings. Tiger can generate Ki from critical unarmed strikes. Tortoise can generate Ki from specified defensive successes. Crane provides mobility and support but does not create free out-of-combat healing. A single event can satisfy more than one generator, but total gain still cannot exceed the appropriate own-turn or off-turn ceiling.

Temporary maximum-HP reductions caused by Monk features do not stack on the same creature; use the largest reduction from your Monk features. Maximum HP cannot be reduced below 1. Unless a card specifies an earlier end, the reduction lasts until the creature completes a short or long rest. Restoring maximum HP does not restore current HP. These effects are temporary combat trauma, not unstated permanent injuries.

card.name: Martial Apex (Capstone)
card.rangeAndTarget: One Monk Action technique you are beginning to use
card.effect: Martial Apex. Tags: arch, capstone, action. When at exactly 5 Ki, spend all 5 as you begin a Monk technique that normally requires an Action. That technique does not consume your normal Action but counts as the one additional full Action allowed to you that round. Add one additional copy of its base rolled damage dice to one damage roll. It cannot be used on healing-only techniques or a Hero Final. Spending all 5 Ki replaces only that technique's printed Ki cost; any RP, rest-use, target and recharge requirements are still paid/met. The bonus dice apply to one target only, cannot copy critical bonus dice, and cannot generate further attacks or resources.

source.originalText: Martial Apex (Capstone): At 5 Ki, your next ability costs no action and deals +100% damage (1/encounter).

card.name: Ribcrusher Strike
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by your unarmed strike
card.duration: Until target completes a short or long rest
card.effect: Ribcrusher Strike. Tags: hero, iron-fist, attack, max-hp. After an unarmed strike hits, spend 2 Ki. The target makes a Constitution save. On failure reduce its maximum HP by S+M, minimum maximum HP 1. This reduction follows the common non-stacking maximum-HP rule and is restored after a completed short or long rest without restoring current HP.

source.originalText: Ribcrusher Strike: Heavy strike, reduces enemy max HP by 10% (2 Ki).

card.name: Bone-Breaking Strike
card.duration: Until target completes a short or long rest
card.effect: Bone-Breaking Strike. Tags: hero, iron-fist, attack, max-hp. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit, the target makes a Constitution save. On failure reduce its maximum HP by 2 S+M under the common non-stacking maximum-HP rule. This creates no persistent broken-limb injury; the maximum returns after a completed short or long rest without restoring current HP.

source.originalText: Bone-Breaking Strike: Deliver a powerful blow that can temporarily reduce the target's maximum health.

card.name: Deathless Silence
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three enemies you can perceive within 60 feet
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn; max-HP reduction until rest
card.effect: Final — Deathless Silence. Tags: hero, shadow, final, teleportation, max-hp, weave. Until the start of your next regular turn you cannot be targeted by opportunity attacks or Reactions. Teleport adjacent to up to three different chosen enemies in sequence and make one unarmed strike against each. On each hit, the target makes a Constitution save. Failure reduces its maximum HP by 4 S+M under the common non-stacking rule and suppresses one non-core defensive passive it possesses until the end of its next turn; the Director identifies an applicable visible passive before the save. This does not disable core class engines, legendary rules or creature type traits.

source.originalText: Final – Deathless Silence: Untargetable 1 turn → teleport to 3 enemies and apply Void Palm (max HP -25%, passive disable).

card.name: Death Touch
card.effect: Death Touch. Tags: hero, shadow, attack, finisher. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit add 3 S d8 necrotic damage. If the target began the strike at or below one-quarter maximum HP, it also makes a Constitution save; on failure add another 2 S d8 necrotic damage. This never causes automatic death, bypasses no ordinary dying rules and creates no permanent injury beyond the damage actually dealt.

source.originalText: Death Touch: Legendary technique that can potentially kill a weakened target instantly by stopping their heart.

classRecords.text: RC RECOVERY. A completed long rest restores RC to maximum. A completed short rest restores 1 spent RC, never above maximum. Each Mystery has exactly one Prophecy Trigger. During a real encounter, your Prophecy Trigger can restore at most 1 RC per round and never above maximum. Trivial enemies, willing staged targets, summoned sacrifices, repeated corpse abuse, copied damage, copied healing and events generated solely to trigger recovery do not qualify.

Copied, echoed, repeated or redirected damage/healing uses only the explicitly copied numeric component. It cannot repeat RC recovery, Prophecy Triggers, action grants, conditions, passive triggers, resource restoration or another copy effect unless the copying feature explicitly says otherwise.

Oracle zone default: choose at most three allies and three enemies for each pulse or aura benefit, fixed at activation unless the card names fewer. Persistent damaging/healing zones require concentration and at most three pulses. Pay 1 RC before each pulse after the first, or end the effect; once-per-long-rest Finals include their printed pulses in that limited use. One pulse can affect a creature only once per round. Passive personal resistance and a single-target temporary buff are not zones.

card.name: Mystery Surge
card.rangeAndTarget: One Tier II Revelation you are activating
card.effect: When you activate a known Tier II Revelation, choose one applicable surge: increase its Revelation attack roll or save DC by 1 for that use; add S to one rolled damage or healing result; or increase one printed non-concentration duration of 1-2 rounds by 1 round. A Surge cannot create additional Actions, targets, RC recovery or hard-control repetitions.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6 and a known Tier II Revelation

card.name: Burning Blood — Boon V
card.rangeAndTarget: Self; up to three enemies/allies within 15 feet
card.effect: 1/long rest as a Bonus Action become a living pyre for 3 rounds. At the start of each hostile creature's turn within 15 feet it takes S d6 fire damage. Once per your turn when at least one enemy takes fire damage from you, regain 1d6 HP, capped at S+M HP per turn. Allies in the aura gain fire resistance and hidden/invisible creatures within 10 feet cannot benefit from mundane darkness or visual concealment against creatures illuminated by your pyre.

value.name: Burning Blood
value.blurb: Air kindles your spilled blood into a fire that harms friend and foe alike
limitations: When slashing or piercing damage wounds you, you and adjacent foes take 1d4 fire damage as your blood sparks
You cannot benefit from cold-based healing or resistances; your curse rejects the chill
Open wounds glow faintly, imposing −2 to Stealth until treated or until you rest

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Resistance to fire. Melee attackers take 1d4 fire damage when they hit you with a weapon attack. Your wounds smolder briefly — enemies within 1 tile take 1 fire damage when your blood first ignites each round.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Spend 1 Revelation Charge to ignite your blood — your next Revelation deals +50% fire damage and cannot be extinguished by mundane means. While ignited, slashing and piercing damage against you no longer sparks fire on adjacent allies; the Crown's flame answers only to your will.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When your blood ignites from damage, allies within 2 tiles gain +10% weapon damage for 1 round as shard-fire answers your pain. You may extend the flare to 3 tiles by spending 1 Revelation Charge — enemies in the burst take 1d4 fire damage as embers leap from your wounds.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Blood flare: when reduced below 50% HP, erupt fire in a 3-tile burst (once per short rest). Enemies take fire damage; you are not harmed by your own flare.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, become a living pyre for 3 rounds — fire aura in 3 tiles; enemies take fire damage at start of turn; you heal 1d6 when an enemy takes fire damage from you. Allies in the aura gain fire resistance and treat your ignited blood as bright light that reveals hidden foes within 2 tiles.

value.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

card.name: Consumed — Boon V
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to three allies within 10 feet
card.effect: 1/long rest as a Bonus Action fully embody your Mystery for 3 rounds. Gain immunity to the theme damage type, +2 on Revelation attack rolls and Revelation save DC, and add S to one Revelation damage or healing roll each turn. Allies within 10 feet gain +1 AC. Visible transformation cannot be suppressed during this embodiment.

value.name: Consumed
value.blurb: Your Mystery remakes your body until its element shows through
limitations: As you gain levels, your appearance shifts toward your Mystery's theme: flame hair, starlit eyes, bone protrusions, and the like
Some civilized NPCs react with fear or awe; concealing the change in formal courts requires ongoing effort
As your body changes, armor and gear must be refitted periodically (roleplay / downtime cost)

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Gain +5% resistance aligned with your Mystery's element or theme (fire, necrotic, force, psychic, etc.). Once per day, suppress visible transformation for 1 hour in civilized areas — the Mystery still leaks through divination.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Elemental skin: +1 AC while wearing light or no armor as your flesh hardens into mystery-matter. Unarmed strikes and natural weapons you wield count as magical and deal +1d4 thematic damage.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Mystery infusion: weapon and touch attacks deal +1d4 thematic damage matching your Mystery. Revelation potency visibly bleeds into your strikes.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Partial transformation: ignore difficult terrain tied to your Mystery (fire walks, shadow steps, temporal stutter, etc.). Allies who follow within 1 tile during the same round may treat that terrain as normal ground until your next turn.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, fully embody your Mystery's element for 3 rounds — immunity to that damage type, +2 effective Revelation potency, and visible manifestation (aura, wings of flame, star corona, etc.). Allies within 2 tiles gain +1 AC as your transformation steadies the battlefield; suppression is impossible while the embodiment lasts.

value.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

card.name: Host's Cry
card.effect: Allies in range gain +S damage on one weapon hit per turn and reduce the first damage they take each round by 1. Once during this Cry, when a qualifying ally reduces a meaningful hostile creature to 0 HP, that ally regains 1d6 HP and you regain 1 RC, never above maximum. This special refund can occur only once per Host's Cry and still obeys the once-per-round RC recovery ceiling.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Host's Cry
value.description: Spend 1 charge: allies within 4 tiles gain +10% weapon damage and +5% DR for 2 rounds as the War Chorus roars through you; the first ally to drop an enemy while the cry persists regains 1d6 HP and you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per cry).

card.name: Fury of the Host
card.effect: For 2 rounds, each ally in range may once on its regular turn gain one additional full Action usable only for one ordinary weapon attack or Dash/Move, subject to the universal extra-Action cap. Allies also gain +1 on attack rolls and reduce the first damage they take each round by 1. You gain +2 AC and immunity to Frightened. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Battle Revelation for 0 RC using its normal action type. The first qualifying ally each round to reduce a meaningful enemy to 0 HP regains 1d6 HP. When the effect ends, you are suffering Revelation backlash until the end of your next turn: -1 on attacks and saves and Speed -5 feet. Concentration is required; choose at most three allies for its benefits. Each granted Action may make only one ordinary weapon attack or Dash, and cannot grant another action.

value.name: Fury of the Host
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, allies within 5 tiles gain +1 action per turn (attack or move only), +10% crit chance, and +5% DR as the War Chorus banners them — you gain +2 AC and immunity to Fear; once per round you may cast one Tier I Battle Revelation at no cost, and the first ally to drop an enemy each round regains 1d6 HP. After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

card.name: Death's Threshold
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.duration: Until healed above half maximum HP
card.effect: The first time after a short rest that you fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less, activate Death's Threshold. Until you are healed above half maximum HP, reduce the first necrotic damage and first nonmagical weapon damage you take each round by S and gain +1 to your Revelation save DC. Undead enemies within 3 tiles take -1 on their first attack roll against you each round. The effect then ends and cannot reactivate until after another short rest.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Death's Threshold
value.description: When reduced below 25% HP, gain +10% necrotic resistance, +5% DR vs non-magical damage, and +1 to Revelation saves until healed above half HP (once per short rest) — the Pale Ledger marks you as owed, not finished; undead within 3 tiles hesitate to target you (−10% hit on their first attack each round while below threshold).

card.name: Ledger's Memory
card.effect: Gain advantage on checks to identify undead, poison and disease. Once per long rest, touch one corpse and learn its identity if the Pale Ledger could reasonably know it, its approximate time of death and the direct physical or magical cause of death. This does not reveal the killer's identity unless the corpse or supernatural Ledger actually knows it.

value.name: Ledger's Memory
value.description: Advantage on checks to identify undead, poison, and disease. Once per day, consult the Pale Ledger for the name and cause of death of any corpse you touch.

card.name: Bones Revelation Mastery
card.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
card.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Marrow Drain: a living target hit also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. Enhanced Ledger's Command: may target up to 3 undead, but all controlled undead still share one Bonus Action command per round. Enhanced Unfinished Chorus: when its drain resolves, you may always redirect the healing to one ally within 3 tiles of you rather than yourself; its healing cap remains S+M.

value: Enhanced Marrow Drain: also slows target movement by 1 tile
Enhanced Unfinished Chorus: you may redirect drained HP to an ally within 3 tiles

card.name: Flame Prophecy Trigger
card.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
card.effect: When one of your Revelations restores HP to a living ally or deals fire damage to a meaningful hostile creature, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. One Revelation use can restore at most 1 RC even if it both heals and burns or affects multiple targets.

originalObjects.value: When you heal an ally or burn an enemy with a Revelation, regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round)

card.name: Wrathful Brand
card.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Brand at a time
card.effect: Mark one enemy. The next damaging attack you hit it with before the Brand ends adds fire damage equal to half that attack's unmodified rolled base damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1. If an ally damages the marked target before the Brand ends, that ally regains 1d6 HP once per Brand and the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it has -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Wrathful Brand
value.description: Spend 1 charge: mark one enemy with burning judgment for 1 round — your next attack against them deals +50% fire damage; if an ally attacks the marked target before the brand fades, they heal 1d6 and the target must save or suffer −10% hit until end of next round as cursed embers cling.

card.name: Purging Flame
card.duration: Instantaneous; attack penalty until end of undead target's next turn
card.effect: If the target is a living ally, it regains 1d8+M HP and may end Poisoned or immediately repeat one saving throw against a disease that normally permits saves. This removes no Wounds. If the target is undead, make a Revelation attack; on hit it takes 1d8+M fire damage and makes a Constitution save, suffering -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn on failure.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Purging Flame
value.description: Spend 1 charge: touch one ally within 1 tile to end one disease or poison and heal 1d8 + your Charisma modifier; undead touched instead take equal fire damage and must save or suffer −10% hit for 1 round as cursed ash clings.

card.name: Crown's Burn
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.duration: Damage/healing instantaneous; penalties until end of next turn
card.effect: Enemies in the burst make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6+M fire damage on failure or half on success. A failing enemy also has -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. Total the actual fire damage dealt to meaningful hostile creatures, then divide by the number of allied recipients chosen in the burst; up to three living allies in the burst each regain the lesser of that share or S d6+M HP, minimum 1 if any qualifying damage was dealt. Each healed ally reduces the first fire damage it takes before your next turn by S.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Crown's Burn
value.description: Spend 2 charges: unleash a 3-tile burst of shard-fire — enemies take 2d6 fire damage and must save or suffer −10% hit until end of next turn; allies in the burst heal half the total damage dealt to enemies (minimum 1d6), and the Crown's embers cling — allies healed this way gain +5% DR vs fire until start of your next turn.

card.name: Zealot's Renewal
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.rangeAndTarget: One living ally within 3 tiles; adjacent enemies
card.duration: Instantaneous; fire ward until start of your next turn
card.effect: The ally regains 2 S d8+M HP, then takes 1d4 fire backlash that cannot be reduced below 1 unless First Flame Convergence suppresses it. It may end Poisoned or immediately repeat one disease save. Until the start of your next turn it reduces the first fire damage it takes by S. Hostile creatures adjacent to the healed ally take 1d4 fire damage once from scattering embers.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Zealot's Renewal
value.description: Spend 2 charges: one ally within 3 tiles regains HP equal to your Charisma modifier × level tier (minimum 1d8) but takes 1d4 fire backlash — wrathful healing; the Crown's embers cling — they end one minor poison or disease, gain +5% DR vs fire until start of your next turn, and adjacent enemies take 1d4 fire as cursed ash scatters from the renewal.

card.name: First Flame Convergence
card.effect: For 2 rounds, once on each of your turns when a Flame Revelation deals fire damage, add one extra die matching that Revelation's primary damage die to one damage roll. Once per turn when one of your Flame Revelations damages a meaningful hostile creature, one living ally within 4 tiles regains 1d6 HP. Allies within 4 tiles are immune to Frightened. Once per turn when this effect heals an ally, that ally reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1. Zealot's Renewal deals no backlash while Convergence lasts.

value.name: First Flame Convergence
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, your fire Revelations deal +25% damage and allies within 4 tiles heal 1d6 when you burn an enemy — you emit warm light and allies are immune to fear; the Crown's memory kindles: once per turn when you heal via wrathful fire, one ally within 4 tiles gains +5% DR until start of your next turn, and Zealot's Renewal backlash is suppressed during the convergence.

card.name: Flame Revelation Mastery
card.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
card.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Wrathful Brand: its maximum duration becomes 2 rounds. Enhanced Crown's Burn: its healing may target up to three living allies within 4 tiles of the burst center rather than requiring them inside the burst. Enhanced First Flame Convergence: Zealot's Renewal backlash remains suppressed for the full Convergence duration; if already suppressed by the base effect, additionally one ally healed by Zealot's Renewal during Convergence gains S temporary HP.

value: Enhanced Wrathful Brand: mark lasts 2 rounds
Enhanced Crown's Burn: allies need not be in burst to receive healing
Enhanced First Flame Convergence: no backlash on Zealot's Renewal during effect

card.name: Flame Prophecy
card.rangeAndTarget: One known Flame Revelation; allies within 4 tiles
card.duration: Chosen Revelation; secondary effects until end of your next turn
card.effect: Activate one known Flame Revelation for 0 RC. Until the end of your next regular turn, the next Zealot's Renewal or other Flame Revelation you use that has self-damaging healing backlash ignores that backlash, and allies within 4 tiles reduce the first fire damage they take by S. The next time you damage a creature already suffering ongoing fire damage before the effect ends, add S fire damage once.

value.name: Flame Prophecy
value.description: Once per day, the Crown of First Flame kindles through you — cast any Flame Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, your next wrathful heal this encounter deals no backlash and allies within 4 tiles gain +5% DR vs fire; burning enemies you hit take +10% fire damage until end of next turn.

card.name: Crown Restored
card.effect: Manifest the Crown for 3 rounds. Once on each of your turns add 2 fire damage to one damaging attack or Revelation. At the start of each living ally's turn within 5 tiles, including yours, that ally regains 1d6 HP, at most three pulses per creature from this Final and never above maximum HP. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Flame Revelation for 0 RC using its normal action type. Free Revelations cannot recursively restore additional RC beyond the normal once-per-round Prophecy Trigger cap.

value.name: Crown Restored
value.description: Once per day, manifest the Crown of First Flame for 3 rounds: +2 fire damage on all attacks, allies within 5 tiles regenerate 1d6 per round, and you may cast Tier I fire Revelations at 0 cost once per round.

card.name: Resonant Seed
card.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Seed zone at a time
card.effect: When a living ally starts its turn in the zone, it regains 1d4 HP, at most once per round and for at most three pulses from this use, and may end Frightened or Poisoned on the first pulse it receives. Undead entering or starting their turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant damage once per round and make a Strength save; on failure their Speed is reduced by 1 tile until the end of that turn. Healing requires the paid 1 RC activation and ends after 3 rounds.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Resonant Seed
value.description: Spend 1 charge: plant a resonant seed in a 2-tile zone within 4 tiles for 3 rounds — allies starting turn there heal 1d4 and end one minor condition; undead entering or starting turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant and must save or suffer −1 movement until end of turn.

card.name: Life Revelation Mastery
card.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
card.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Overflowing Light: maximum temporary HP from excess healing becomes 20. Enhanced Garden of Restoration: the first Garden pulse a creature receives may end both Poisoned and one disease that explicitly allows magical curing, rather than only one of those benefits. Enhanced Song of Mending: duration becomes 3 rounds and gains one additional 2d6 healing pulse at the start of your second later regular turn; each ally still receives only one 1-HP death prevention per use.

value: Enhanced Overflowing Light: temp HP max 20
Enhanced Garden of Restoration: also removes poison/disease on entry
Enhanced Song of Mending: duration 3 turns

card.name: Radiant Path
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.rangeAndTarget: 5-tile line originating from you; enemies and up to 3 allies in line
card.duration: Instantaneous; star-ash until end of your next turn
card.effect: Enemies in the line make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6+M radiant damage on failure or half on success. Failed enemies are covered in star-ash until the end of your next turn and cannot benefit from mundane concealment. Choose up to three living allies in the line; roll 1d6 once and each regains that much HP if at least one meaningful hostile took damage, maximum healing per ally S+M if lower. After resolution, you and one chosen ally in the line may each move 1 tile along the Path without provoking opportunity attacks.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Radiant Path
value.description: Spend 2 charges: trace a line of star-fire up to 5 tiles — each enemy in the path takes 2d6 radiant damage and is marked with star-ash for 1 round; allies in the path heal half the total damage dealt (minimum 1d6); the Celestial Concord maps the route — you and one ally may shift 1 tile along the path without provoking before the radiance fades.

classRecords.text: Base progression is explicit rather than the ordinary 25-card template: at 1 automatically gain Lay on Hands, Divine Sense, Martial Proficiency, Divine Strike, Protective Stance and Sacred Touch. At 2 gain Righteous Challenge, Bolstering Presence, Fighting Style and ordinary Paladin spell access. At 3 swear ONE of ten Oaths; gain only its Smite modification, Aura and first Revelation spell. This Oath is the Arch specialization. At 10 enter Hero Oath Mastery of that SAME Oath; no second Oath or additional generic Hero tree. Signature Power unlocks 11, Final Gift 20. Oath Revelations automatically unlock 3/5/9/13/17, always known in addition to the shared spell repertoire, rank 1/2/3/4/5 respectively. Exact printed RP costs replace generic cost only if the card explicitly supplies them.

At 2 choose one Fighting Style: Defense +1 AC while armored; Dueling +2 damage to first one-handed melee hit on your own turn; Protection Reaction impose disadvantage on one attack against an adjacent ally when using a shield. At 3 Divine Health gives advantage on disease saves, not universal immunity. At 5 Extra Attack makes two attacks when taking the ordinary Attack Action; named attack techniques use their own counts. These three features reconcile preserved main-registry entries; other old level-table extras, including extra level 14 ASI and undefined free slot riders, are not stacked into this draft. ASI/feat at 4/8/12/16/19 follows general advancement once.

Divine Strike at 1: after one melee weapon hit on your regular turn, spend 1 RP to add S d6 radiant. At 2 this becomes Divine Smite: choose 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for(S+1)d8 radiant, once/own turn total. Oath 3 changes type/rider as its card states, never adds another copy of the base damage. Smite is not an ordinary spell, cannot be counterspelled or generically Overcast, and causes no Dissonance. A critical hit doubles Smite damage dice under ordinary rules, but never healing, resources or percentage copies.

Protected interface: Smite, Aura and Lay on Hands generate no Weave Dissonance. After a successful direct melee hit, your next Oath spell before end next turn generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0, consuming the benefit. No stacking, RP discount or Refrain reset. Oath Revelation spells and the five replacement Forbidden spells below are ordinary spells for strain, countering and concentration; signature powers and final gifts are Oath techniques unless expressly tagged otherwise.

Oath conduct clauses remain intact in source and Oath cards. The Director identifies a relevant clause and a knowingly chosen serious breach before applying a fall. A disagreement, failed roll, coerced act or unknown fact does not silently remove a character. A fall is an explicit story transition recorded with the player: choose the corresponding Oathbreaker inversion or pursue an agreed restoration scene. Preserve class level and already spent resources. Oathbreaker replaces its Oath Aura, Smite rider, Signature and Revelation list, rather than stacking both sets. Base martial abilities remain; Lay on Hands becomes Death Touch using the same current 5 L pool, with no refill on switching.

Death Touch baseline: Action melee divine attack PB+CHA; declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points before the attack from remaining Lay on Hands pool to deal that much necrotic damage (choose amount before roll; miss still spends declared points). Each Oath inversion may alter type or add its bounded rider; never copy innate traits, confiscate class engines or automatically execute a target. A listed inverted Signature is available only at 11 and replaces the ordinary Signature use, one/short rest. An inverted aura follows the same radius, target cap and timing. Oathbreaker 20 uses the new Black Manifestation common capstone instead of its original Final Gift.

Oath integration limits: one paid Smite total per round, including the level-7 Reaction; one Oath-aura reactive event per round. Multiple damage-redirection options share one event per round unless Crown Undying expressly allows two. Apply original-target defenses once, then split actual damage; transferred damage cannot be mitigated again, reflected, redirected again or generate resources. This explicit rule supersedes wording that permits recipient defenses again.

The source ceiling’s half-pool-per-round Lay on Hands cap is a preserved alternative. This pilot instead uses maximum class level per ordinary Lay on Hands Action and the explicitly once-per-long-rest level-17 Wave that distributes the current remaining pool. No normal heal gains the Wave’s exception.

For any one damage event choose exactly one Paladin redirection feature. Using it consumes the shared redirection allowance for that round. Crown Undying permits two DIFFERENT ally-damage events per round, but still only one redirection feature may modify each event.

card.name: Blighted Benediction
card.effect: New rank 1 Forbidden spell. Divine spell attack; hit S d8 necrotic and target-1 on next attack roll. No healing, command or second strike. Ordinary spell strain applies.

card.name: Dread Shelter
card.effect: New rank 2 Forbidden spell. Gain 2 S+M temporary HP on casting and 1 flat DR against weapon damage for duration. No recurring temp HP pulse or healing.

card.name: Black Manifestation
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 enemies in aura
card.effect: New Oathbreaker Final: gain 2 S+M temporary HP; chosen enemies WIS save or lose Reactions and Speed-10 ft for duration. Refresh one expended Signature use, then pay its normal Action and other costs when used. No Death Touch pool, RP, extra Action or Final reset.

card.name: Death Touch — Life Drain
card.cost: Declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points from current Lay on Hands pool, even on miss
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature within melee reach; up to 2 additional living creatures within 5 feet
card.frequency: At will while Lay on Hands points remain; rider once per turn
card.effect: Make a melee divine attack using PB+Charisma. On hit the primary target takes necrotic damage equal to the declared Lay on Hands points. Then up to 2 other living creatures within 5 feet make Constitution saves, taking S necrotic damage on failure or half on success. Regain HP equal to half the total actual necrotic damage dealt by the secondary drain, rounded down, maximum S+M. Constructs and undead provide no healing.

originalObjects.value: Life Drain AoE — steal life from all creatures around you

card.name: Exsanguinate
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living creatures in your Oath aura
card.effect: Each target makes a Constitution save, taking 2 S d8 necrotic damage on failure or half on success. Regain HP equal to half the total actual damage dealt, rounded down, maximum Paladin level+M. Undead and constructs are unaffected and cannot be used to generate healing.

originalObjects.value: Exsanguinate — drain life in large radius, heal self for damage dealt

card.name: Death Touch — Malicious Execution
card.cost: Declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points from current Lay on Hands pool, even on miss
card.frequency: At will while Lay on Hands points remain; rider once per turn
card.effect: Make a melee divine attack using PB+Charisma. On hit deal necrotic damage equal to the declared Lay on Hands points. If the target was already at or below half maximum HP, it makes a Constitution save; on failure add S d6 necrotic damage. This rider never automatically executes or bypasses normal death rules.

card.name: Death Touch — Blighting Blood
card.cost: Declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points from current Lay on Hands pool, even on miss
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature within melee reach; its occupied space
card.duration: Damage instantaneous; blighted space until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At will while Lay on Hands points remain; terrain rider once per turn
card.effect: Make a melee divine attack using PB+Charisma. On hit deal necrotic damage equal to the declared points and blight the target's space until the start of your next turn. The first hostile creature other than the original target that enters or starts its turn in that space takes S necrotic damage. The patch creates no corpse, healing or resource trigger.

card.name: Thorn Crown
card.rangeAndTarget: Creature that just imposed a condition on you within 60 feet
card.effect: Trigger after a hostile creature causes you to fail a save and gain a finite-duration condition. The source immediately makes the same type of saving throw against your Oath DC. On failure it suffers the same named condition until the end of its next turn, subject to the universal hard-denial guard. Your original condition is not removed unless another feature removes it. Thorn Crown cannot reflect damage, death, curses, Wounds, resource loss or permanent transformations.

originalObjects.value: Thorn Crown — reflect status effects back at attacker (1/rest)

card.name: Chain of Duty
card.effect: Mark the ally. If it is reduced to 0 HP while within 60 feet and on the same plane, you may use your Reaction to teleport to an unoccupied space adjacent to it. This teleport prevents no damage and does not heal either creature. The spell then ends.

value.spell: Chain of Duty — mark ally; teleport to them when they fall

card.name: Memorial Flame
card.rangeAndTarget: 30-foot-radius light centered on a point within 30 feet
card.effect: The memorial light reveals hidden or invisible undead within it unless an effect explicitly defeats divine detection. Allies in the light gain +2 on death saves. Hostile undead in the light have disadvantage on attack rolls. The light does not damage undead or reveal non-undead invisible creatures.

value.spell: Memorial Flame — conjure 30-ft memorial light for 1 minute; reveals hidden undead, grants allies +2 to death saves, and undead in light have disadvantage on attacks

card.name: Crown of Embers
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies in your Oath aura
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: Selected allies reduce the first damage they take before the start of your next turn by S. During this period you may redirect damage from one selected ally to yourself without using a Reaction, once total for the Crown, up to Paladin level+M damage. Redirected damage retains type and cannot be redirected again. The Crown grants no healing by itself.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 11; Oath of the Martyr King

originalObjects.value: Crown of Embers — team-wide DR + damage redirection (1/rest)

card.name: Burden Shared
card.activation: Reaction when an ally takes damage
card.rangeAndTarget: Triggering ally and up to two other willing allies in your aura
card.effect: After applying the original target’s defenses once, divide up to Paladin level+M of the remaining damage among the willing recipients as you choose; each recipient must explicitly accept its amount. The original ally takes the remainder. Transferred damage keeps its type and cannot be reduced again, redirected, reflected or trigger healing/resources. This uses the one redirection event per round.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 9; Oath of the Martyr King

value.spell: Burden Shared — distribute damage among willing allies

classRecords.text: Chosen Hero grants a sixth Arrow at 11. Warder Nature's Wrath: ranged attack weapon+S d6 piercing; up to 2 allies within 10 ft gain M temporary HP (finite mitigation, not repeatable real healing). Stalker Phantom: two ranged attacks against different aligned targets within 60 ft, each weapon damage, no extra dice; one Arrow activation. Outrider Corruption: place 10 ft-radius zone within 60 ft, concentration until start next turn; up to 3 enemies entering/starting there take S d4 necrotic once each, CON half. Arrow copies cannot generate extra attacks, resources or permanent terrain changes.

card.name: Healing Briar
card.rangeAndTarget: Fixed 10 ft-radius natural-ground zone within 30 ft; 3 allies/pulse
card.effect: On start heal 1d8+M per chosen living ally; on next 2 turns Bonus Action+1 RP repeats pulse. Maximum 3 pulses; no passive additional entry healing and no Wound removal.

source.originalText: Healing Briar: Establish a healing zone that restores health to allies within it.

card.name: Beast Companion
card.cost: 4 RP; 1 hour with a willing/tamed eligible beast
card.effect: Bond eligible beast using standard companion stats plus Wisdom modifier HP; preserve one movement mode up to 40 ft and keen-sense advantage. Bonus Action command gives one attack, no imported boss powers. Injury persists; heal normally. Death requires a new bond after long rest, not free resummoning.

source.originalText: Beast Companion: Tame one beast from the bestiary (CR ≤ your level, INT < 7, not corrupted) as a permanent companion that scales with your Wisdom and level.

classRecords.text: On your turn you may spend Bonus Action to move one totem up to 15 ft along unobstructed ground, remaining within 60 ft. This competes with healing maintenance, companion commands and advanced flasks. Moving an aura over a creature cannot trigger its once/round effect repeatedly. Totem destruction creates no resource return. Once per round, the first ordinary spell cast while inside your own active totem aura generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0; no RP reduction.

The book places Flask Use at Base but describes advanced flask casting as Theurgist/Soothsayer-only. For this draft, Base Flask Use grants mundane prepared tactical flasks thrown with an Action; at Hero 10 only Theurgist/Soothsayer gain magical Bonus Action flasks. Bloodcaller retains mundane alchemical knowledge, not the advanced flask subsystem. At long rest prepare 2 flasks, rising to 3 at 5 and 4 at 11; no encounter refill or stockpiling, total carry cap 4, unused contents become inert when preparing a new batch. This finite-rest supply replaces encounter-based free heal farming.

Flask tier uses S. Mundane Base modes: Burn=one enemy 30 ft DEX save S d6 fire half, failure 1d4 fire next turn; Root=one ground enemy 30 ft STR save Speed 0 until end its next turn; Weaken=one enemy 30 ft CON save or-1 attack damage until end its next turn. Advanced Hero modes additionally: Stun=one enemy 30 ft CON save or no Reactions, failure by 10 Stunned until end its next turn; Heal=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Restore=end Frightened or Poisoned on one ally 30 ft. Every thrown flask consumes one prepared unit and 2 RP for advanced magic (Base mundane flasks cost 0 RP). Changing payload requires no separate crafting action when throwing. No flask leaves harvestable poison or another flask.

card.name: Extended Totem Duration
card.cost: 0; full upkeep for extra Renewal pulse
card.effect: Totems last 1 extra turn. Renewal may have a fourth pulse only if you pay Bonus Action+1 RP on that turn; no fifth pulse and no automatic free healing. Concentration still required.

source.originalText: Extended Totem Duration: Totems last for an additional round.

card.name: Spirit Cache
card.rangeAndTarget: One flask/to-tem effect you directly used
card.effect: Store its profile, not an active copy. On a later turn use normal Action/Bonus Action and pay all RP and a new flask unit or full totem cost to repeat it. Add 1d6 to one numerical damage/heal amount; no copy of refund/limited use.

source.originalText: Spirit Cache: Store one flask or totem effect to recast later (once per encounter).

card.name: Totem Pulse
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures inside newly placed non-healing totem
card.effect: On placement pay 1 RP: allies gain M temporary HP OR enemies make DEX save for S affinity damage, half on success. No immediate second Renewal healing pulse, no repeat from moving the totem.

source.originalText: Totem Pulse: Totems create an immediate area effect when placed (level 6).

card.name: Spirit Saturation
card.effect: Waive its 2 RP placement cost once. Still use Action, concentration, capacity and any added costs. Cannot create a healing totem or be cached/refunded to generate more free casts.

source.originalText: Spirit Saturation: Gain one free totem cast per combat (level 9).

card.name: Echo Totem
card.rangeAndTarget: Adjacent empty space within 5 ft of newly placed totem
card.effect: Create a weak echo anchor of that totem. It counts toward capacity; if no space in capacity, cannot create it. Its radius 10 ft and numerical bonuses/healing are half, rounded down. Shared concentration/upkeep and same-name nonstacking prevent double healing.

source.originalText: Echo Totem: Automatically cast a second, weaker totem when placing your primary totem.

card.name: Elemental Harmony
card.effect: Add class level to its maximum/current HP on creation and 1 turn duration, maximum 4 turns for class summons. Cannot extend once/day Chorus beyond 4 turns or restore an existing creature's lost HP.

source.originalText: Elemental Harmony: Your elemental summons gain increased duration and health.

card.name: Summon Cinderflame
card.effect: Summon standard Cinderflame. Commanded hit deals fire plus Burn 1d4 next target turn. On destruction only (not dismissal), up to 3 enemies within 5 ft make DEX save for S d4 fire, half. Explosion creates no further death/resource triggers.

source.originalText: Summon Cinderflame: Create a fire spirit that applies burning damage over time and explodes on death.

card.name: Healing Splash
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living allies in 5 ft radius within 30 ft
card.effect: Each regains S d6+M HP, shared roll. This consumes a flask and replaces its normal payload. No damage to enemies, free conditions removed or resource refunds beyond the explicit once/day Predictive Alchemy.

source.originalText: Healing Splash: Convert a damage flask into an area healing effect.

card.name: Elder Spirit Accord — new Hero capstone
card.effect: When starting Elemental Chorus, Omen Loop or Bloodroot Trail, reduce its RP cost by 3, minimum 1, and add M to one damage/healing roll from that use. You must know that ability and still spend its own limited use. If you do not know it, instead reduce one known Hero technique's RP cost by 3, minimum 1. No extra duration, flask, totem, command or repeated cast.

classRecords.text: Base 1–2, Commander Arch 3–9, then Champion/Artillerist/Tyrant Hero 10–20. Palisade 5 is automatic; Intercepting Shot has minimum 6 and Fortify Zone 9. Other cards require selection. There is no source automatic Arch capstone. At 20 gain the new Final Command below, clearly a playtest addition. No spell or sustained technique may be used to obtain infinite ammunition, structures, actions or permanent healing.

card.name: Precision Engineering
card.effect: Increase maximum and initial HP by M. Does not heal existing damaged structures when learned or moved; repairing remains finite.

source.originalText: Precision Engineering: Your deployed structures have increased durability and effectiveness.

card.name: Brutal Example
card.rangeAndTarget: One enemy below half HP in weapon range
card.effect: Weapon attack; on hit add 2 S d6 damage. Up to 2 enemies within 10 ft of victim WIS save or Frightened of you for duration. No automatic death threshold or fear through immunity.

source.originalText: Brutal Example: Deal massive damage to a weakened target, causing nearby enemies to become frightened.

classRecords.text: At 1 know all four Tier I recipes, at 7 add Tier II, at 14 Tier III. Poison saving throws use Thief DC except preserved source fixed DC 12 becomes max(12, Thief DC) for Mindburn/Venombite. Unless stated damage/conditions require a failed CON save; initial weapon damage is unaffected. Critical riders also need this failed save. One ongoing instance of each recipe per target; another application refreshes rather than stacks. Maximum 2 simultaneous different poison recipes from you per target. Bleed never stops all healing by default, Poisoned uses the Core V 2 condition: disadvantage on attacks and ability checks (not saving throws), and Shaken means disadvantage on next fear save. Neither is a hidden full-turn disable.

Tier I: Bloodleech gives Bleed 1d4 at start next 2 target turns; critical restores 1d4 of your HP, once per dose. Crippler gives-1 on next attack before end next turn; critical also half Speed for that duration. Mindburn uses WIS save: -1 spell-attack rolls until end next turn, critical also no Reactions. Venombite gives Poisoned until end next turn; critical also-1 on next save. Tier II: Ashblood adds 2d6 poison now and 1 fire at start next 2 turns; critical prevents HP recovery through end next turn. Silencer prevents verbal spellcasting through end next turn, critical also drops one held nonbonded item into its space; it can retrieve normally. Shiver gives Shaken through end next turn; critical also no Reactions. Hexroot gives-1 saves for 2 target turns; critical lets next weapon hit ignore resistance, never immunity, before end next turn.

A destroyed drone remains 0 HP until repaired for 1 RP and 10 minutes with tools to half HP, once/short rest, or rebuilt during long rest to full. Ordinary repairing does not recharge devices, grant organic healing or trigger destruction bonuses. At 13 Dual Drone Protocols automatically chooses on each long rest either 2 basic drones each with one module, or one drone with 2 distinct modules. Still one command budget. Never more than 2 drones.

Base 1–2, Mechanist Arch 3–9, then Artificer/Techsmith/Warmachine Hero 10–20. Upgrade Slot 5 is automatic; Sentry and Net minimum 6, Remote Detonation 9. There is no source automatic Arch capstone. Mech Overdrive 20 is automatic: once/long rest when deploying choose one device whose duration becomes encounter end (maximum 1 minute), still command dependent, slot limited and destructible. No infinite pulses: healing effects keep original pulse cap and all per-use costs remain. Protected magic interface: once per short rest, as a Bonus Action route up to 2 current Dissonance into one of your active devices within 30 ft. Reduce Dissonance by that amount; the device is disabled and cannot move, attack, emit an aura or trigger effects until repaired or your next completed short rest. Its duration keeps ticking. Repair with an Action and 1 RP using Field Repair, or with 10 minutes and 1 RP using tinkers tools. No RP is created and no Refrain counter resets.

card.name: Quick Fingers
card.effect: Open unlocked latch, operate simple switch or retrieve a carried gadget. Does not activate damaging/healing devices, disarm a trap, reload every weapon or add another Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Quick Fingers: Perform device activation and manipulation actions with increased speed.

card.name: Deployable Expertise
card.effect: Gain M maximum/initial HP and+1 AC. Does not heal existing damage when moved or grant additional slots. Drones excluded unless another card says otherwise.

source.originalText: Deployable Expertise: Your deployed devices have increased durability and effectiveness.

card.name: Protective Programming
card.rangeAndTarget: Drone adjacent to ally hit by attack
card.effect: Drone grants ally S+M temporary HP before hit resolves. No heal or reversal of hit; max one protected ally, normal temporary HP nonstacking.

source.originalText: Protective Programming: Your drone prioritizes defending vulnerable allies.

card.name: Efficient Power Cells
card.effect: A 3 round device lasts 4 rounds (50%rounded down). Healing pulse count unchanged, no extra ammunition or free commands. Does not extend spell concentration.

source.originalText: Efficient Power Cells: Your devices last 50% longer before needing recharging.

card.name: Nano-Aegis Drone
card.effect: Replace bolts with support mode. Each Bonus Action command pay 1 RP choose one ally 30 ft to heal S d6+M or grant 2 S+Mtemp HP. Maximum 3 pulses; organic healing explicit exception, no attack during mode.

source.originalText: Nano-Aegis Drone: Replace your combat drone with a healing/shield drone that protects allies.

card.name: Restoration Field
card.cost: 3 RP start; 1 RP maintenance; one slot
card.effect: Concentration. Initial and paid Bonus Action pulse heals up to 3 living allies/devices S d6 HP. Devices must not be destroyed. Same creature once/round, no extra autonomous healing or longer Efficient Cells.

source.originalText: Restoration Field: Create an area that gradually repairs mechanical devices and heals organic allies.

card.name: Technical Mastery
card.effect: After damage rolld 10; on 10 you may pay 1 RP to add half its unmodified damage dice total rounded down to one target. No second activation, commands, procs, resources or healing duplication.

source.originalText: Technical Mastery: Your devices have a 10% chance to function twice when activated.

card.name: Reconfiguration
card.effect: Change between known nonhealing profiles using same HP fraction, slot, expiry and spent uses. Cannot turn a 1 slot device into two, refill ammo, reset trap, create fresh death trigger or morph drone into free bomb.

source.originalText: Reconfiguration: Transform one deployed device into another type.

card.name: Scrap Reaper
card.effect: Create one Scrapling Speed 30, AC 12 HP L; next Bonus Action command moves and detonates within 5 ft one enemy for 2 S d6 fire DEX half. Uses one command budget and ends. No chain from deliberate sacrifice or its own death.

source.originalText: Scrap Reaper: When a turret or drone dies, summon a Scrapling that chases and explodes on enemies.

card.name: Mech Overdrive
card.cost: 1 long-rest use plus original deployment cost
card.rangeAndTarget: One of your newly deployed devices
card.effect: Source-derived level 20 feature: extend device duration only. It still occupies its slot, requires normal commands and payments, and is destructible. Healing devices keep maximum 3 pulses; bombs, spent uses and expended charges never refill. Does not create permanent equipment.

source.originalText: You begin with one deployable slot and gain additional slots as you level up. At level 20, you gain Mech Overdrive, allowing one device to become permanent for the duration of a battle.

classRecords.text: HEALING AND REGENERATION. Warrior healing cannot exceed maximum HP, restore the dead or remove Wounds unless a card explicitly says otherwise. Regeneration and repeated healing effects operate only during real encounters unless their card explicitly permits downtime healing. No corpse, summoned creature, trivial enemy or friendly target can be used to create infinite healing, serum doses or BT.

card.name: Mutation Overload
card.duration: 2 rounds; backlash until end of following turn
card.effect: Mutation Overload. For 2 rounds, enhance each currently active mutation once: an AC, DR, attack, save or flat-damage bonus increases by 1; a movement or reach bonus increases by 5 feet; or one mutation damage/healing roll gains +1d4. Immunities, target counts, resource generation and action grants cannot be increased. When Overload ends, you suffer -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and -5 feet Speed until the end of your next regular turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the Strain cap.

source.originalText: Mutation Overload: Push your mutations beyond safe limits, gaining significantly enhanced effects for 2 rounds followed by exhaustion.

card.name: Pain Empowerment
card.effect: Pain Empowerment. For every full 10% of your maximum HP currently missing, add +1 damage to one weapon or natural-weapon damage roll on each of your turns, maximum +5. Determine the bonus immediately before the chosen damage roll. Healing can reduce the bonus during the encounter. It does not increase mutation retaliation, ongoing damage or area effects.

source.originalText: Pain Empowerment: Gain +5% damage for each 10% of health you are missing.

card.name: Primed
card.effect: Enhance one active mutation's numeric benefit for the turn: +1 to one AC, DR, attack, save or flat damage bonus; +5 feet to one movement/reach bonus; or +1 damage/healing to one mutation-generated roll. Primed never increases duration, targets, immunity or resource generation.

source.originalText: | Primed | Deal 50% of max HP as damage | Active mutations gain +25% effectiveness |

card.name: Transcendent
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: At Warrior 12+, the first time this encounter you cross 100% Brutality Progress or reach stored BT 4, activate all equipped mutations until start of your next regular turn. No serum profile or immediate healing trigger is granted. This is one total pulse, never a permanent BT 4 concurrency increase. At end choose active mutations up to normal limit, with their original remaining durations; others become dormant.
card.prerequisite: Warrior 12; 100% Brutality Progress or BT 4 with raised cap; new explicit level gate

source.originalText: | Transcendent | Deal 100% of max HP as damage | All mutations active simultaneously for 1 round |

card.name: Sanguine Surge
card.frequency: Per prepared dose; same creature cannot receive its healing more than once per short rest
card.effect: On injection regain 2d6 HP and gain +10 feet Speed for 3 rounds. Side effect: when the profile ends gain 1 additional Strain, maximum 3. Serum Tolerance suppresses that ending side effect. This healing removes no Wounds and cannot operate on a dead creature.

source.originalText: | Sanguine Surge | Heal 2d6 | +10 ft speed | 3 rounds | Increased Hunger |

classRecords.text: ABJURATION, provisional completion for the omitted eighth row: once per round after you cast an Abjuration spell, gain temporary HP equal to PB until the start of your next regular turn. CONJURATION: creatures summoned by your Wizard spells gain +1 maximum HP per Wizard level. DIVINATION: once per long rest reroll one failed saving throw and use the new result. ENCHANTMENT: when a creature fails its initial save against one of your Enchantment spells, a printed control duration of at least 1 round may last one additional round, but every normally allowed repeat save still occurs. EVOCATION: when casting an area Evocation spell, exclude one creature from its initial damaging area; that creature automatically succeeds and takes no damage if success normally halves damage. ILLUSION: gain +2 on concentration saves made to maintain Illusion spells. NECROMANCY: once per turn during a real encounter when a hostile non-summoned creature dies from your Necromancy spell, gain 1 temporary HP; it is not permanent healing. TRANSMUTATION: after casting a Transmutation spell, gain +5 feet Speed until the end of that turn.

MATRIX MASTERY MODIFICATIONS. After acquiring Matrix Mastery, each prepared ordinary spell matrix may carry at most one modification chosen during preparation. QUICK SUBSTITUTION: once per short rest, replace one matrix marked Quick Substitution with another spellbook spell of exactly the same rank using a 1-minute ritual instead of the normal 10-minute midday swap; the replacement loses the modification until the next long rest. COMPONENT ENHANCEMENT: when casting a damaging or healing matrix, spend 1 additional RP to add one extra die of the spell's primary damage or healing die to one roll; if the spell has no such die this modification has no effect. MATRIX LINKING: pair two different prepared matrix families during preparation; after legally casting one, the other costs 1 less RP, minimum 1, if cast before the end of your next regular turn, at most once per pair per round. STABILITY REINFORCEMENT: gain +2 on concentration saves caused by damage while maintaining that matrix. A matrix modification never creates another spell cast or proc event.

card.name: Arcane Sanctuary
card.rangeAndTarget: You and up to eight willing creatures within 15 feet
card.effect: Arcane Sanctuary. Tags: hero, spellbinder, final-theorem, demiplane. Perform a 10-minute ritual to open a temporary demiplane and transport the willing targets inside. For 1 hour creatures inside cannot cast or activate harmful magical effects and magical effects originating outside cannot enter. Nonmagical violence remains physically possible, ordinary healing and communication may function, and creatures can leave through the visible exit as an Action. When the hour ends all occupants return to the entry location or nearest legal spaces.

source.originalText: Arcane Sanctuary: Create a demiplane of safety for 1 hour where harmful magic cannot function (1/week).
